Rooms.Name: Start of the sandy track
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself on a sandy track that leads east to what seems to be a 
small town. You hear little noise except for some soft melodic music and you
feel quite at peace in this tranquil place.  A large temple lies just
south of here.

Exits.Description: The trail continues in that direction.

Rooms.Name: The sandy track
Rooms.Description:
The track becomes harder here and the sand thins out. The walking is
easier on this harder ground and you start to look forward to what may
be ahead. The sound of wildlife and the song of the birds adds to your
mood.

Exits.Description: You see the start of the sandy track.

Rooms.Name: The stone path
Rooms.Description:
Now the track is paved and is shaded by large ornamental hedges on
either side. The hedges are beautifully trimmed and it is evident that a
lot of care and attention has gone into the landscaping. You realize that
the people inhabiting the town must be very meticulous and proud.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to Old Japan
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself in a large open area. All around you there are neatly
manicured plants and flowers. The smell is enchanting and your spirits
are lifted. You decide that it was a good idea that you decided to venture
so far from home after all. As you take in the astounding beauty a large
banner that seems to be made from paper rustles in the wind and raises your
interest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The banner reads:

         Welcome to the palace of the Emperor Nazaki.
         All are welcome to explore the grounds and
         to pay homage to the great Emperor himself,
         who extends his hospitality to you. Please
         visit the monks in the shrine and they will
         help you find enlightenment and peace within
         yourself.

Rooms.Name: South-west corner of the square
Rooms.Description:
You are standing along the border of the square. The exquisitely tended
hedges reach up far above your head and you wonder how they are kept in
such a good condition, surely they are too high to be reached. The square
continues to the east and to the north you can see the entrance to the town.

Rooms.Name: Southern side of the square
Rooms.Description:
You are at the southern-most side of the town square. From here you can
see the whole square and the view is magnificent. To the west and east are
the corners of the square and in the distance to the north you spy a small
trail leading away from the square. One thing strikes you as a little odd,
the hedge here seems slightly discolored and a little more tatty than the
other parts are. Also to the north it looks as though something has been
demolished.

Exits.Description: You can just see through the discolored hedge.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You try to push the hedge and you find that it gives a little.

Rooms.Name: The small, dusty trail
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself on a small trail leading southwards. The air is cooler
here and the light seems fainter as if dusk were setting in. You put this
down to the fact that the large hedges are blocking most of the light but
you can't help but feel a little disconcerted. All around you insects are
buzzing and humming and this eerie melody only darkens your mood. To the
south the trail continues, but for some reason you can't really see where
it is going.

Exits.Description: The discolored hedge is to the north

Rooms.Name: South-east corner of the square
Rooms.Description:
The whole of the square looks beautiful. All the flowers are in full
bloom and bees hum quietly around looking for pollen. To the north you can
see the bordering hedges and to the west you can nearly make out the trail
which you followed here.

Rooms.Name: Eastern side of the square
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at the side of the square directly opposite from where
you entered. You can see the center of the square to the west and to the
east there is a wide bordered path which leads up to a large building. The
building appears to be a kind of temple, most probably the residence of the
Emperor, you think to yourself.

Rooms.Name: North-east corner of the square
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at the corner of the great square still finding it hard
to believe that such a work of beauty could be accomplished. You ponder over
who actually looks after the garden, and decide that whoever it is must be
endowed with strange and wonderful talents.

Rooms.Name: Northern Side of the square
Rooms.Description:
You can see the whole square from here and it looks quite beautiful. To
the south you notice that the hedge directly opposite is slightly different
in color to the rest of that side, but you decide it must just be the way
the light reflects off it. To the north there is a gap in the hedge but it
has been filled by a large pile of rubble, which presumably was at one time
an arch of some description. Anyway, it does not look as though you will be
able to climb it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The rubble looks quite fresh, as though whatever it was has only been 
   destroyed quite recently.

Rooms.Name: North-west corner of the square
Rooms.Description:
You are in the top corner of the square. It seems to be a little higher
here than at other places and you are able to just peek over the southern
hedge. What you see is quite an awesome sight, a volcanic mountain shrouded
in mist climbs up into the heavens. You are not able to make out much detail
due to the thick mountain mists, but it quite a wondrous sight. From here
the square extends to the east and south.

Rooms.Name: The center of the square
Rooms.Description:
Here at the center of the square you can take in all the beauty of your
surroundings. The mystical music you heard earlier can be heard more strongly
now, but its source is indiscernible. From here you can see the white path
leading east from the square and the temple behind that. To the west you
recognize the path you entered on, and to the south you notice that the hedge
is a slightly different color to the rest of the border.

Rooms.Name: The rice path
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a white path that seems to be made from rice. It makes
a strange crunching noise as you walk on it and you wonder what the purpose
of it is. To the east you see that the path continues on to a large temple.

Rooms.Name: On the rice path
Rooms.Description:
You follow the white path quite enjoying the funny sound you are making.
To the north you see there is a small enclave and also an identical looking
one to the south. It appears that they house flowers and some ornamental
statues.

Rooms.Name: A small enclave
Rooms.Description:
You are stood in a small enclave that appears to be a flower garden of
some kind. The flowers are beautifully arranged and the smell is intoxicating.
To the south, past the path, you see a similar enclave.

Rooms.Name: A small enclave
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a small enclave that appears to be a flower garden of
some kind. The flowers are beautifully arranged and the smell is intoxicating.
To the north you see a similar enclave past the white path.

Rooms.Name: In front of the temple
Rooms.Description:
You are stood in front of a grand temple. The architecture is stunning
and you are truly awed by the sight. It is quite intimidating. The steep 
roof reaches down to nearly touch the floor and the light reflects off the 
tiles hurting your eyes. To the east there are some large engraved doors.

Rooms.Name: The Emperor's temple
Rooms.Description:
You are at the end of the paper screen. You can now see to the east where
a small passage leads to the great long hall of the Emperor. A smell of fine
foods is wafting from the east.

Rooms.Name: The temple foyer
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself in a large open space. The temple appears to be just
one large room that is separated by paper-like screens. You can see through
the screens slightly as they are quite translucent in the light, but you
can only make out faint outlines. Along the walls hang great tapestries which
depict wars and horrible monsters. The screen prevents your way eastwards
but you can move north or south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The tapestries depict scenes of battle, mainly between samurai and ninja.
However these are not the only parties involved, spectral images haunt
the backgrounds of the pictures.

Rooms.Name: The Emperor's temple
Rooms.Description:
To the east you see a small passage. It leads along the outer wall of the
temple and is quite plain. This room is tidy and clean but there is little to
see.

Rooms.Name: The dusty trail
Rooms.Description:
You are following a dusty trail which is getting steeper as you go. You
hear the sound of people and animals to the south and smoke is rising in a
steady pattern. It appears there may be some sort of settlement ahead. The
trail continues south for a short while and then turns. You can go back to
the square by traveling north.

Rooms.Name: On the dusty trail
Rooms.Description:
The trail is quite firm and the going easy. The path turns here and now
leads to the east. The sounds of people are getting closer and you hope that
the inhabitants will be friendly. However, the mist that surrounds this place
is less than inviting.

Rooms.Name: The path steepens
Rooms.Description:
The path you are on begins to rise a little and you can now see a little
way into the distance. The thick mist prevents you from seeing too far but
you are approaching some foothills by the look of things. Further away to
the south you can see the rocky peaks of a small mountain range. The path
continues to the east for a short way, but you can always change your mind
and return to the west.

Rooms.Name: A turning in the path
Rooms.Description:
You are at a turn in the path. The trail continues to the south where it
rises up into some foothills. The mist seems thicker now and a chill begins
to set in. You are beginning to feel slightly uncomfortable and rub your hands
together to keep warm. The trail is quite steep now, and you can just make out
a few wooden shacks to the south. Back to the west you can make your way to the
square.

Rooms.Name: The path to the shacks
Rooms.Description:
You are on a path that leads into a small gathering of huts. They appear
quite run down, but inhabited nonetheless as you can see smoke rising from
the small chimneys. All seems quite except for a chattering sound, like a
child's rattle. The path leads south between the shacks.

Rooms.Name: Path between the shacks
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small dirt path. To the east and west there are small, wooden
shacks. There is little noise from inside and you wonder whether whoever owns
them is hospitable or not. Smoke rises from the small chimneys and you wonder
whether you should take a look inside.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see two small wooden shacks standing opposite one another.

Rooms.Name: Inside the small shack
Rooms.Description:
You are stood inside a small shack. The smell is terrible in here, like food
that has rotted away. There is a small table and a couple of chairs scattered
around the room. The northern wall houses a fireplace and glowing coals try
to add a little warmth to this cold abode. You look around for exits but it
appears that this is the only room. The small futon lying on the floor seems
to confirm this.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see a small wooden table. On it lie a few scraps of food which are rotten
and do not look in the slightest bit edible.

The small chairs are in drastic need of repair and it seems they would collapse
if you were to sit on them.

The glowing coals in the fireplace try in vain to give the room a little
warmth.

Rooms.Name: A small shack
Rooms.Description:
You are standing inside a small shack, which it would appear, houses at
the maximum, only two people. It is tiny and squalid. There is a small table
and a futon lying on the floor, which the owner must use as a bed. You decide
that there is nothing much to see here as the hut is just a single room. The
door you entered by leads back to the path outside.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The futon appears to be a small bed where the owner(s) of this place sleep.

Rooms.Name: Between the shacks
Rooms.Description:
To the east and west you see two more shacks. They look very much the same
as the two to the north. They are just as decrepit and smelly. The path leads
north and south or you can hold your nose and enter one of the huts.

Rooms.Name: The smelly shack
Rooms.Description:
The smell in here is disgusting. You don't know what caused it and you
don't think you really want to. There is no furniture at all in here. All
there is that prevents this hut just being a wooden box is a small fireplace
in the western wall. The door leads back out to the east.

Rooms.Name: Another wooden shack
Rooms.Description:
This shack is a little larger than the others but it smells just as badly.
The fire has gone out in the fireplace and is very chilly. It makes you
feel like you should have stayed away from this place. The door leads back
out to the path to the west.

Rooms.Name: The mountain trail
Rooms.Description:
You are on a trail leading up towards a small mountain range. The small
gathering of shacks is to the north, and fortunately the wind has picked up
enough to take the smell of them away. The path turns quite sharply here and
you may continue along it to the west.

Rooms.Name: The mountain trail
Rooms.Description:
The trail is made from a hard substance that seems quite porous. It is
light-gray in color and crunches a little as you tread on it. Around you
through the mist you once again hear the sound of animals, but they sound
larger than before. You trail gains height and leads to the south once again
but the way back is to the east.

Rooms.Name: The fireplace
Rooms.Description:
AGGGGGGGGGGGHHHHHHHHHHHH, it's a tight squeeze but you just manage to
crawl into the fireplace. The coals are glowing hot and you have burnt
yourself quite badly. You attempt to pull yourself out and back into the 
room but find yourself completely stuck. The wind starts to get up outside
and suddenly a gust comes down the chimney. The flames start to rise and 
soon catch on to your clothing. You pull harder but just cannot budge yourself
from this mess. Eventually your hair starts to burn and you smell your own
flesh cooking. You die an agonizing and slow death here in a smelly hut!
What a fitting end for a hero such as yourself!

Rooms.Name: The steep path
Rooms.Description:
This part of the path rises sharply up to what looks like a small plateau.
It looks as though there is some greenery up there but it is difficult to say.
You can hear the sound of running water from far over to the west but there is
no way you can see that far in this fog. If you like you can return towards the
shacks on the path to the north, or if you feel like braving what lies ahead
south is the direction in which to travel.

Rooms.Name: The marshy path
Rooms.Description:
The path has become quite wet here. You feel yourself sliding in the
mud. It seems there must be water somewhere close by. To the east it seems
that the path rises slightly and hardens up some. To the west it looks
decidedly boggy. The road into the small village leads back to the north.

Rooms.Name: A mountain trail
Rooms.Description:
The trail is harder again here and it appears to be made of the same
gray rock as you saw earlier. The trail rises slightly and leads to the
east.

Rooms.Name: The mountain trail
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small track that appears to have been made by animals
although there are larger footprints here. The path is narrow and there
is a relatively large drop to the north of you. The path continues on to
the east.

Rooms.Name: A turn in the mountain path
Rooms.Description:
You are at the edge of a small precipice. To the north and east there
are sheer cliff faces. A thin crumbling path leads to the south and appears
to end at a rock face.

Rooms.Name: A narrow path on the mountain
Rooms.Description:
You are on a path approaching a cliff face. It is narrow and you have to
be careful not to fall down the cliff. The view from here is astounding
and you can see for miles even through the mist. The cliff face is along
to the south.

Rooms.Name: Outside a small opening
Rooms.Description:
You are right up against the cliff face now. It stretches high up
into the sky and you wonder whether there could be a path leading up
there somewhere. To the east you see a narrow gap that you may just be
able to squeeze in to it if you dare. The trail also leads back to the
north.

Rooms.Name: The small, dark cave
Rooms.Description:
You are stood in a small cave that stinks of putrefaction and death.
All around you are bones and limbs amongst other things. Creatures have
made nests in the remains here and maggots run freely over the floor.
To the south there seems to be a thin crack in the wall and west will
take you back outside.

Rooms.Name: The secret store
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself in a small alcove that has been hollowed out of the
rear or the cave. There is not much to see as it's a pretty small room.

Rooms.Name: The marshy path
Rooms.Description:
The path has become decidedly more marshy and less path-like now and
you hope that you will not sink altogether. You can hear the sound of 
running water quite clearly now from the north-west. Exits lead east
and west.

Rooms.Name: The sinking path
Rooms.Description:
The path has become more of a mire now and to the south you can see
a small expanse of water to the south which seems quite still. It may
be the source of the river you can hear.

Rooms.Name: The source
Rooms.Description:
You are swimming in ice cold water. There is not much vegetation around
due to the biting coldness, but small reeds and rushes extend from the
surface in places. There is more water to the south and west.

Rooms.Name: The source
Rooms.Description:
You are swimming in a pool of water that meets the cliff face to the
south, it may be possible to climb out there if you can find any hand-holds.
To the north and west is more water but it seems to be running a little
faster to the west.

Rooms.Name: The foot of the mountain
Rooms.Description:
There is a steady stream of water running down the mountain here which
gathers in a pool to the north of you. To the south the cliff face stretches
high into the sky and there is no way to climb straight up. You will have to
follow the small path, which appears to have been made by goats, eastwards
if you want to try to climb up.

Rooms.Name: A trail up the volcano
Rooms.Description:
As you walk along the path you can see through the mist slightly. This is
actually a volcano, not just a mountain after all. The gray rocks you have
seen must be pumice stone. Smoke rises in thin wisps from the peak and you
hope that this particular volcano isn't active. The trail continues on east
from here which appears to be the only way up the mountain from here.

Rooms.Name: The source
Rooms.Description:
The water here is running much faster and in a northerly direction.
To the south there is a rocky slope leading into the pool. To the north
you see that the pool becomes a small river and flows away down the cliff.

Rooms.Name: The source
Rooms.Description:
You feel as though you are being pulled along by the flow of the water
and have to swim against it. There are strange noises coming from the
south but you aren't sure if they are caused by the flow of water or not.
There is more water east and south of you and the pool becomes a small
river to the north.

Rooms.Name: The small river
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small but fast flowing river which is proceeding at a
steady pace down the mountain-side. The current is strong but you are
able to swim against it. It flows northwards into the thick mist and 
you cannot easily tell where it leads to. You can always fight the current
and return southwards if you wish though.

Rooms.Name: On the small river
Rooms.Description:
The river is much faster here and you can hear a loud crashing sound to
the north. Rocks jut out of the river at curious angles and the sides of
the river are smooth stone, from where the water has grooved it's path. You
can continue north further down the river or you may wish to try to swim
back upstream to the south.

Rooms.Name: The small river rapids
Rooms.Description:
You are at the terminus of the river. The flow is extremely fast here and
it is difficult to stay afloat. All around you the waves crash and the noise
is deafening. If front of you to the north the river crashes over the edge of
the cliff in an astoundingly beautiful waterfall, the spray from which causes
a rainbow to appear in the haze. You may swim back up the river southwards or
you may dare to risk the hazards of the waterfall.

Rooms.Name: The waterfall
Rooms.Description:
WHHHHHHHHHHHHOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAA, what a thrill. You are traveling down
the mountainside at a ridiculous speed and the excitement is immense! However,
there are also HUGE rocks at the bottom of the fall! As you plunge down you
notice them and then they flash by, you missed them! Unfortunately the under-
current is so strong here at the bottom that there is no way you can break
the surface once you have been pulled under. You manage to hold your breath
for a while but then the strain becomes too much and you inhale a lung-full
of water. What they say about drowning isn't right and your death is agonizing!

Rooms.Name: The volcanic trail
Rooms.Description:
You are following a small gray trail along the mountainside. The trail
is thin and the gusty wind makes this trek quite treacherous. The view is
superb, even through the mist. You can see the Emperor's temple in all its
magnificence and the small shacks you passes over to the north-west. From
here the trail leads southwards into what looks like a lava gully.

Rooms.Name: The volcanic trail
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small gully carved from the rock by previous flows of lava.
It looks like the going may get tough here as the trail appears to end. You
will have to try to make your way up the mountain without the aid of a path
now. You may wish to turn back and head northwards or risk the climb upward.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the volcano
Rooms.Description:
You are hanging dangerously on the mountainside. It is difficult going
but you are managing to slowly edge yourself upwards. Eastwards there seems
to be a thin ledge that you may be able to stand on.

Rooms.Name: A ledge on the volcano
Rooms.Description:
You are teetering precariously on a small ledge hundreds of feet up the
volcano. It leads in a southerly direction towards a large opening in the
rock face. The ledge is very steep and it appears you will have to climb at
least some of the way.

Rooms.Name: A ledge on the volcano
Rooms.Description:
The ledge is slightly wider now and your footing more secure. Above you
and to the south there seems to be a cave of some sort and the trail leads
you in that direction apparently.

Rooms.Name: A ledge on the volcano
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a small ledge far up the mountainside. To the south
you see a large, dark cave while the ledge seems to go east where it meets
a more stable and wider path.

Rooms.Name: A cave in the volcano
Rooms.Description:
The cave is huge and dark. Shadows flicker and scatter unnervingly from
your light source and you feel ill at ease. It is difficult to tell how
this cave was created as the walls are jagged rather than smooth and there
appears to be no other openings around.

Rooms.Name: The ledge widens
Rooms.Description:
You are on what seems to be a small platform. The ledge is much wider
here but is seems some subsidence has caused this part to slip and you
will have to climb up to continue your ascent.

Rooms.Name: The volcanic trail
Rooms.Description:
The ledge now becomes a trail once again. It winds around a jagged
outcrop of rock and it is difficult to tell where it is leading to.

Rooms.Name: The winding path on the volcano
Rooms.Description:
The path curves around quite sharply and you have to be careful not to
fall off the edge. The path extends a little to the east but does not look
particularly safe there. It may be safer to follow it to the south or even
to return west.

Rooms.Name: The path crumbles
Rooms.Description:
OOOOOOOOOHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH NNNNNNNNNNOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO
The path crumbles beneath your feet. You slip and slide down the mountain
side, but are able to eventually grab hold of a tree. But, as luck would
have it, and in the spirit of irony the tree breaks sending you plummeting
to your death hundreds of feet below.

Rooms.Name: Outside a cave on the volcano
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small path that winds around the volcano. The going is tricky
but you think you are progressing well. To the south is a wide opening that
seems to be a cave, whereas the path continues to the west. North leads back
down the mountain.

Rooms.Name: A cave in the volcano
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small cave hewn out of the rock by some unexplainable force.
There is very little of interest here and the wind moans across the entrance
making you feel uneasy. You may exit the cave to the north.

Rooms.Name: A trail on the volcano
Rooms.Description:
The trail is beginning to thin out again and before you know it you are
up against a vertical climb. There is no way around it so you will be forced
to climb up. The way back leads to the east.

Rooms.Name: Near the summit of the volcano
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small plateau. Looking around you can see for miles. The island
is larger than it appears at first and you can see strange lands far away. The
sea looks rough, but from this height you can get no real impression of the
size of the waves. A few scattered vessels can be seen being tossed around by
the elements and you feel glad to be on land. As you are on a much flatter area
the mist does not obscure your view so badly now and you can see a well used
path winding along to the south.

Rooms.Name: On the volcanic plateau
Rooms.Description:
Large rocks jut out of the ground all over the place and you have to
follow the trail around these. The going is much easier as you do not have
to fight a slope now and you can see the smoke pouring from the opening at
the top of the volcano. Although it makes you quite uneasy it is a stunning
sight. The trail leads south still where it appears to curve around another
crag.

Rooms.Name: The volcanic plateau
Rooms.Description:
The trail you are following comes to a sharp turn to the east here. From
there it looks as though it will lead southwards but the outcrops make it
difficult to tell.

Rooms.Name: The wide volcanic pathway
Rooms.Description:
The trail become much wider here and it looks as if a conscious effort
has been made here to lay a path. It looks as though this part of the mount
is inhabited by someone, or something. This particular path leads south to
a very large opening in the rock face.

Rooms.Name: Outside the large cave
Rooms.Description:
You are stood in front of an extremely large cave entrance. Above the
cave there appears to be a ledge which you should be able to climb up to.
The entrance to the cave is south or if you wish to explore the ledge you
can climb up to it.

Rooms.Name: The great cave in the volcano
Rooms.Description:
You are stood inside a huge cave which seems to be a natural crevice in
the mountainside. The walls are covered in arcane signs which have been
painted in blood. Small evil-looking creatures scurry about in the shadows
and a sticky-looking goo drips from the ceiling in places creating a horrible
atmosphere.

Rooms.Name: The Lair
Rooms.Description:
You are on top of a small outcrop of rock which is covered in grasses
and moss. All around bones and scraps of meat litter the floor. It seems
the be the lair of a group of creatures, but what would be living up here?
You may climb back down to the path if you wish as you can see no other
exits.

Rooms.Name: A tunnel inside the volcano
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a tunnel which leads into the actual volcano. The
walls are jagged and coarse and the floor is uneven. You can actually
feel the heat emanating from the walls of the tunnel and you hope that
it won't get much worse as you go onwards. The tunnel continues to the
south but you can reenter the cave to the north.

Rooms.Name: The tunnel inside the volcano
Rooms.Description:
The tunnel you are in now turns to the east. The heat is getting much
worse the further you go into the volcano and you are beginning to sweat.
Strange noises can be heard from the east but you put this down to the
lava gurgling inside the volcano.

Rooms.Name: The tunnel inside the volcano
Rooms.Description:
The tunnel now opens out into a large cavern to the south. Back to the
west you can follow the tunnel out of the volcano if you wish.

Rooms.Name: The lair of the Dai-Oni
Rooms.Description:
This huge cave is decorated with human corpses. They hang from the roof,
the walls and even decorate the floor in places. An enormous throne stands
against the southern wall. It is made from bones and the head-rest from large
skulls. It is covered in human skin, which is beginning to rot creating a
disgusting smell. The tunnel is to the north but that appears to be the only
exit from this vile place.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The throne is huge and made of human bones. The sight of it makes you want
to vomit.

Rooms.Name: A passage in the temple
Rooms.Description:
You are stood in a small passage. It leads east to what seems like a long
hall. There are some nice smells coming from the eastern direction.

Rooms.Name: The long hall
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a long hall that leads northwards. A short way to the
north there is a grand looking throne. The eastern wall is decorated with a 
large assortment of weapons and armor and is quite a stunning sight.

Rooms.Name: Before the Emperor's throne
Rooms.Description:
In front of you is a beautiful throne made from bamboo and the finest cloth.
It is the throne of the Emperor and is beautiful in design. To the north and
south you can follow the hall and from the west comes the smell of fine food.

Rooms.Name: The long hall
Rooms.Description:
You are at the northern end of the long hall. To the south you see the 
great throne of the Emperor. The wall to the east is decorated with the
finest weapons and armor. Westwards will take you away from the hall.

Rooms.Name: The passage in the temple
Rooms.Description:
You are stood in a small passage that leads to the grand hall of the
Emperor Nazaki. From somewhere the smell of fine food assails your nostrils
and you begin to feel a little hungry. East will take you to the grand hall
whilst going west should eventually take you out of the temple.

Rooms.Name: The Sushi Bar
Rooms.Description:
You are stood inside a small room that appears to be where the Emperor
and his men eat. There is a small serving hatch behind which you can see
a small man scurrying about trying to prepare his food faster. The smell is
incredible and you want to eat right away. When you are finished you can
enter the hall by going east.

Rooms.Name: The island coast
Rooms.Description:
You are following the coastline of what appears to be a small island.
All around you waves crash into the rocks and the sea breeze whips your
hair about. The you can follow the coastline to the north or south.

Rooms.Name: The island coast
Rooms.Description:
You are walking along a thin stretch of beach which is shadowed by
large cliffs to the east. There is no way you would be able to climb 
them so it would be best to look for a way through.

Rooms.Name: The small cove
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself in a small, natural cove. The water laps up the
sandy bank to a small beach which runs along the length of the coastline.
In the distance a huge mountain peak reaches up into the clouds. An 
impressive range of cliffs block your view east, although you can make 
out a small cave at the base of the cliff.

Rooms.Name: Smugglers Cave
Rooms.Description:
After a short while you become accustomed to the darkness in the 
cave, and take a proper look around. Broken boxes and casks, along with 
various items for the repair of boats are scattered all around this 
area. Judging from the contents of the boxes, you assume that this is 
either the result of smuggling, or of a large scale exploration. Peering
into the darkness at the back of the cave, you notice a narrow tunnel 
heading upwards.

Rooms.Name: Winding Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You struggle to clamber over and around the rocks that fill this 
narrow tunnel. The sound of the sea roars in your ears, and the smell 
of salt stings your nostrils, carried by a strong breeze from the cave 
below. The cave disappears in darkness to the east. A deep rumbling 
almost shakes you from your feet, and fragments of igneous rock rain 
down on your head.

Rooms.Name: Rocky Shaft
Rooms.Description:
The heat and smell of sulphur are very strong at this end of the 
tunnel, which at first sight appears to be a dead end. You soon notice 
however that it is lighter here than elsewhere in the caves, a rocky 
shaft leads straight up from here, and you can see the sky. It's a 
difficult climb, but not for a hardy adventurer like you.

Mobs.Name: ninja warrior
Mobs.LongDescription: A Ninja Warrior is on a quest to slay the Emperor.
Mobs.Description:
The person in front of you is a ninja. He has been trained from birth as
 an assassin and has no equal in this area. He is clad all in black and 
 only his dark eyes are visible through the small slit in his mask. He 
 whispers the word "Akukugara" and looks straight at you. A shiver runs 
 down your spine as a voice that seems to come from nowhere echos 
 "Prepare to die!".

Mobs.Name: monk
Mobs.LongDescription: A monk of the White Lotus has fled the temple
Mobs.Description:
The man before you has a shaved head and wears loose fitting robes.
 He is a peaceful and religious man, a monk who is a member of the
 White Lotus. On his forearms he bares a tatoo of a Lotus Flower.
 His life has been spent practising martial arts to improve his
 self-control. You would be a fool to attack him as his temple has
 been destroyed by the minions of the Evil Daimyo and he is not happy!

Mobs.Name: sumo wrestler
Mobs.LongDescription: A Sumo wrestles to amuse the Emperor
Mobs.Description:
This man is huge. He must weigh over 600 pounds! He is a sumo wrestler
 and one of the Emperor's champions. He is here to provide the Emperor
 with some amusement in these troubled times. You would not fare well
 in a fight against him, if he sat on you it would probably kill you!
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%20 emote wrestles the sumo wrestler to the floor.;
%35 emote charges towards the sumo wrestler attempting to grab him.

Mobs.Name: emperor nazaki
Mobs.LongDescription: Emperor Nazaki sits here on his throne.
Mobs.Description:
He is the Emperor of this peaceful land but of late there has been
 much trouble. The man who acts directly under him- the Daimyo, has
 rebelled and now controls evil forces which are bringing the Emperor's
 land to it's knees. A powerful man and a great ruler- it is a shame
 that this has happened.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%30 cheer sumo;%50 say Why don't you join the fun?;%60 pat sumo

Mobs.Name: rokoru kubi head
Mobs.LongDescription: A disembodied head snaps its teeth at you.
Mobs.Description:
Arrgghh, this is digusting. A human head has actually flown away from
 its corpse and is flying towards you! It is a Rokoru-Kubi an undead
 being, no doubt a direct result from it's slaughter by the Daimyo's
 legion of death. It snaps its teeth at you and attacks. It hasn't
 eaten for a while!

Mobs.Name: bakemono goblin
Mobs.LongDescription: A strange looking goblin eyes you curiously.

Mobs.Name: o-bakemono o bakemono goblin
Mobs.LongDescription: A huge goblin towers over you.
Mobs.Description:
This is a huge goblin, larger that even an ogre or troll and much more
 dangerous. His green, scaly skin looks like it would act as good armour
 and his huge fists look dangerous.

Mobs.Name: totate kumo spider trapdoor
Mobs.LongDescription: A giant trapdoor spider leaps at you.

Mobs.Name: ronin samurai
Mobs.LongDescription: A samurai with no master wanders around here.

Mobs.Name: samurai
Mobs.LongDescription: The Emporer's Samurai searches for the source of evil.
Mobs.Description:
The Emperor has sent the last of his troops on a desperate mission to
 destroy the Evil Daimyo. His power is growing and there have been tales
 of horrific beings living in the mountain regions. He has only one thought
 on his mind, and that is to destroy the Daimyo.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 say We need your help to destroy the Daimyo!;%30 peer

Mobs.Name: shura
Mobs.LongDescription: The ghost of a former warrior drifts by.
Mobs.Description:
The apparition before you is the ghost of a former warrior, maybe even one
 of the Emperor's own samurai. He has been raised from the dead by evil
 magic to fight on the side of the Daimyo and the Dai-Oni.

Mobs.Name: nushi woman beautiful
Mobs.LongDescription: A beautiful woman arouses you.
Mobs.Description:
The gorgeous woman before you is actually a demon in human form. It has
 taken this form in order to seduce and then kill it's victims, so don't
 get any ideas about asking her for a date!
Mobs.ActionScript: %%20 say Well, hello there. Have you got any plans for this evening?

Mobs.Name: mukade worm
Mobs.LongDescription: A huge glowing worm attempts to devour you.

Mobs.Name: shadow demon
Mobs.LongDescription: The Shadow Demon is eating your face.

Mobs.Name: mantis preying demon
Mobs.LongDescription: An enormous preying mantis is preying on you.

Mobs.Name: ninja red
Mobs.LongDescription: A Ninja with a red costume sneaks around.

Mobs.Name: piper man
Mobs.LongDescription: A small man plays melodies on a set of pipes.
Mobs.Description:
The beautiful music you heard must have been played by this man. 
 He is a very skilled musician and has been asked to play to help 
 raise the morals of the Emperor's followers.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%25 emote plays wonderful melodies on his pipes.

Mobs.Name: gardener man
Mobs.LongDescription: A small and wizened man tends the Emperor's garden.
Mobs.Description:
This old man must have a very special skill. It appears as though an
 army of giants would be needed to tend this garden. Maybe he has magical
 skills.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%25 emote trims the hedge.;%10 emote say Stay off the grass!

Mobs.Name: kappa huge green being
Mobs.LongDescription: A huge green being with a flat head bursts out of the water.
Mobs.Description:
The being before you looks like a huge troll of some. Its flat head holds
 water which it needs to breath. The only way you will defeat it is by
 hitting it so much that the water spills from it's head.

Mobs.Name: tiger white ornamental
Mobs.LongDescription: A beautiful ornamental tiger sits here peacefully.

Mobs.Name: daimyo evil
Mobs.LongDescription: The evil Daimyo awaits news of the Emperor's destruction.
Mobs.Description:
This is the man who has caused all the trouble here. The Emperor's
 lands are becoming infested with evil and all because of him! When 
 you look closely though, he dooen't appear to be anything other
 than a human, maybe a good fighter, but he would not have the 
 ability to control all these creatures...
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%20 say So you have found me! Now prepare to die.
;%40 emote orders his Ninja to attack.

Mobs.Name: dai-oni dai oni creature
Mobs.LongDescription: The creature before you is the source of the Daimyo's power.
Mobs.Description:
Ah, this would explain it. The Dai-Oni is a great demon from the spiritual
 planes of existence who has felt that the Emperor's benevolent rule
 was causing too much of a threat to all of the dark-minded creatures
 of the lands. He has come to put that right!

Mobs.Name: shikome ape hairy
Mobs.LongDescription: A weird, hairy ape-like creature runs at you.

Mobs.Name: kracken
Mobs.LongDescription: The tentacles of a Kracken lunge at you.

Mobs.Name: lion mountain
Mobs.LongDescription: A large mountain lion paces about here.

Mobs.Name: bruce lee shopkeeper
Mobs.LongDescription: Bruce Lee is here cooking delights for you to sample.
Mobs.Description:
They were right, Bruce Lee was not dead! All that happened was that by
 some temporal anomaly he was transported back in time and to these lands.
 Bored with acting, and with not much call for it in these parts, he 
 decided to turn his hand to the art of cookery and food preperation.
 In his spare time he teaches the troops the chinese art of Wing Chun
 and his own martial art- Jeet Kune Do.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%50 emote shows his devastating martial arts skills.;%40 pose

Objects.Name: statue buddha
Objects.Description: A golden statue of buddha gleams in the sun.

Objects.Name: mask ninja
Objects.Description: A dark cloth mask lies crumpled here.

Objects.Name: belt strip red cloth
Objects.Description: A strip of red cloth flutters in the breeze.

Objects.Name: belt black cloth strip
Objects.Description: A strip of black cloth flutters in the breeze.

Objects.Name: naginata spear curved
Objects.Description: A long, curved spear stands in the dirt.

Objects.Name: shuriken star metal
Objects.Description: A small metal star lies here.

Objects.Name: tanto black knife evil
Objects.Description: A black knife glows with evil here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The tanto is a hunting knife with a short blade. Instead of tapering
at the end, it has the same type of point as a samurai sword. It is made
of a strange eldritch metal that glows with darkness.

Objects.Name: katana sword dai
Objects.Description: A huge samurai sword has been stuck in the stone here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The Dai-Katana is a huge curved sword, over 45 inches long. It is made
from a strange eldritch metal and the blade is perfectly forged. It seems
that it would cut through even stone!

Objects.Name: futon
Objects.Description: A small futon has been placed against the wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The futon is a small mat that is used for sleeping on.
You notice a small tag on the side of it.

Objects.Name: clothes emperor emperor's
Objects.Description: When you look you think you see some clothes, then you don't.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is difficult to say whethere these clothes are here or not! On minute
they are, the next they seem to phase out of existance!

Objects.Name: boots tabi
Objects.Description: Some boots made of black cloth are crumpled on the floor.

Objects.Name: suit ninja black cloth
Objects.Description: A suit of black cloth lies here in a pile.

Objects.Name: tetsubo club spiked
Objects.Description: A spiked club lies half buried in the ground.

Objects.Name: tekagi strap spikes
Objects.Description: A leather strap with spikes along one side hangs here.

Objects.Name: sushi
Objects.Description: A small bowl of raw fish has been placed here.

Objects.Name: rice bowl
Objects.Description: A bowl, full to the brim with rice, has been left here.

Objects.Name: prawn crackers
Objects.Description: A bag full of yummy prawn crackers is waiting to be taken.

Objects.Name: golden potion glowing
Objects.Description: There is a phial of golden liquid on the floor.

Objects.Name: ring nushi nushi's
Objects.Description: A small black ring with a strange symbol on it has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The ring has a funny symbol sticking out of it that looks a little like
a key. Naaaah, it can't be...Or can it?

Objects.Name: metal lock lock-pick
Objects.Description: A twisted piece of metal lies here in the corner.
